source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.4.1 (PDF 216), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Kisi product ya service ki marketing se pehle market ko samajhna zaroori hai. Is mein yeh pehchanna shamil hai ke mumkina customers kaun hain, un ki zarooratein kya hain aur aap ka product un zarooraton ko kaise poora kar sakta hai.

Misal: agar aap riwayati Pakistani kapre bechte hain to aap ki target market mein woh log hain jo Eid ya shadiyon ki tayyari kar rahe hain, kyunke in mauqon par aam taur par riwayati libas pehna jata hai.

blocks.prompt: August mein school bags ki target market kaun hogi?
blocks.explanation: Woh walidain aur students jo naye taleemi saal (school ke naye saal) ki tayyari kar rahe hain.

items: Pehle market samjhein: customers kaun, zaroorat kya, aap ka product kaise poori karega (Eid aur shadi ke kapre).
